canonical_profile.note: kv_unified=false observed in server log at np=1; serving_profile.json requested block governs

decode_tps.method: 5 measured reps after 2 warmups; long-form story task (~1024 max tokens); unique [tag-seed] prompts; thinking disabled; predicted_per_second from server timings

prefill_tps.method: dedicated --no-cache-prompt instance (port 8932, frozen Invalid Run Handling technique); 5 measured reps; unique [tag-seed] content; cached_tokens=0 verified per rep; implied-t/s cross-check PASS all reps
prefill_tps.prompt_size_note: nominal 4096-word body tokenizes to ~5.5-5.6k tokens with this vocab

ttft.note: first-token estimate = prompt_ms + mean inter-token; 4k prefill ≈ 1.38 s at T=0.2

load_time_note: server-relative log timestamp at 'model loaded' with warm page cache (mmap); cold-cache disk variance not separately measured (measurement limitation)
harness_notes: cache metrics on this runtime verified trustworthy during phase 2 (cached_tokens=0 on no-cache instance; main instance prompts unique); no PF-04-style telemetry artifact
decode stdev 0.06 t/s across reps — thermal/power stable at 9B Q4_K_M on RTX 5070
